messages.content: Determine the least common multiple of 18 and 24, and then use it to find the sum of the digits of the resulting product.

To find the least common multiple (LCM) of 18 and 24, we first list the multiples of each number:
   \begin{align*}
   \text{Multiples of 18:} &\quad 18, 36, 54, 72, 90, 108, \ldots \\
   \text{Multiples of 24:} &\quad 24, 48, 72, 96, 120, \ldots
   \end{align*}

The first number that appears in both lists is 72, so the LCM of 18 and 24 is 72.

The sum of the digits of 72 is $7 + 2 = 9$. Therefore, the sum of the digits of the LCM of 18 and 24 is $\boxed{9}$.
